❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the SI unit of pressure?

The pascal (Pa), equal to one newton per square meter. Kilopascals (kPa) are common in weather reports and engineering.

How many psi are in one bar?

One bar equals 14.5038 psi. Conversely, 1 psi = 6,894.76 Pa.

What is the difference between mmHg and torr?

They are almost identical: 1 torr is defined as exactly 1/760 of an atmosphere (133.322368 Pa), while 1 mmHg is defined via mercury density (133.322387 Pa) — a difference of about 2 parts per billion.
